first: 没有证据就指控他作弊，不过是无稽之谈。
méi yǒu zhèng jù jiù zhǐ kòng tā zuò bì, bù guò shì wú jī zhī tán.
Accusing him of cheating without evidence is merely a baseless claim.
second: 这种能让人长生不老的药，完全是无稽之谈。
zhè zhǒng néng ràng rén cháng shēng bù lǎo de yào, wán quán shì wú jī zhī tán.
The claim that this medicine can make people live forever is complete nonsense.

first: 这份说明言简意赅，几句话就讲清了操作步骤。
zhè fèn shuō míng yán jiǎn yì gāi, jǐ jù huà jiù jiǎng qīng le cāo zuò bù zhòu.
These instructions are concise and complete, explaining the steps in just a few sentences.
second: 她的回答言简意赅，直接说出了问题的关键。
tā de huí dá yán jiǎn yì gāi, zhí jiē shuō chū le wèn tí de guān jiàn.
Her concise answer went straight to the key issue.

first: 千钧一发之际，救生员拉住了落水的孩子。
qiān jūn yī fà zhī jì, jiù shēng yuán lā zhù le luò shuǐ de hái zi.
At the critical moment, the lifeguard grabbed the child who had fallen into the water.
second: 卡车突然失控，他在千钧一发之际跳到了路边。
kǎ chē tū rán shī kòng, tā zài qiān jūn yī fà zhī jì tiào dào le lù biān.
The truck suddenly went out of control, and he jumped aside just in time.

first: 服务员彬彬有礼地为老人拉开椅子。
fú wù yuán bīn bīn yǒu lǐ de wèi lǎo rén lā kāi yǐ zi.
The courteous waiter pulled out a chair for the elderly guest.
second: 他虽然不同意对方的观点，说话仍然彬彬有礼。
tā suī rán bù tóng yì duì fāng de guān diǎn, shuō huà réng rán bīn bīn yǒu lǐ.
Although he disagreed with the other person's view, he remained polite when speaking.

first: 他的语气咄咄逼人，让对方无法安心回答。
tā de yǔ qì duō duō bī rén, ràng duì fāng wú fǎ ān xīn huí dá.
His intimidating tone made it hard for the other person to answer calmly.
second: 谈判时，她提出要求，却没有表现得咄咄逼人。
tán pàn shí, tā tí chū yāo qiú, què méi yǒu biǎo xiàn de duō duō bī rén.
During the negotiations, she stated her demands without being overbearing.

first: 与原作相比，这份译文相形见绌。
yǔ yuán zuò xiāng bǐ, zhè fèn yì wén xiāng xíng jiàn chù.
This translation pales in comparison with the original.
second: 新设备投入使用后，旧机器显得相形见绌。

Once the new equipment was in use, the old machines looked inferior by comparison.

first: 公司严惩造假的负责人，希望借此杀一儆百。
gōng sī yán chéng zào jiǎ de fù zé rén, xī wàng jiè cǐ shā yī jǐng bǎi.
The company severely punished the manager responsible for fraud to warn others.
second: 这次处罚意在杀一儆百，提醒所有商家遵守规则。
zhè cì chǔ fá yì zài shā yī jǐng bǎi, tí xǐng suǒ yǒu shāng jiā zūn shǒu guī zé.
The penalty was intended to make an example and remind all merchants to follow the rules.

first: 骗子的借口都被识破，终于黔驴技穷。
piàn zi de jiè kǒu dōu bèi shí pò, zhōng yú qián lǘ jì qióng.
All the swindler's excuses were exposed, and he finally ran out of tricks.
second: 同样的战术接连失败，球队已经黔驴技穷。
tóng yàng de zhàn shù jiē lián shī bài, qiú duì yǐ jīng qián lǘ jì qióng.
After the same tactics failed repeatedly, the team had exhausted its limited options.

first: 这位乡村医生为病人鞠躬尽瘁，几十年没有离开山村。
zhè wèi xiāng cūn yī shēng wèi bìng rén jū gōng jìn cuì, jǐ shí nián méi yǒu lí kāi shān cūn.
This rural doctor devoted himself tirelessly to his patients and stayed in the mountain village for decades.
second: 她为保护古建筑鞠躬尽瘁，把一生心血留在了这座城。
tā wèi bǎo hù gǔ jiàn zhù jū gōng jìn cuì, bǎ yī shēng xīn xuè liú zài le zhè zuò chéng.
She devoted her life to preserving historic buildings in this city.

first: 缺钱也不能铤而走险，去做违法的事。
quē qián yě bù néng tǐng ér zǒu xiǎn, qù zuò wéi fǎ de shì.
Being short of money is no reason to take a desperate risk and break the law.
second: 为了赶路而铤而走险，翻越封闭的山道，太危险了。
wèi le gǎn lù ér tǐng ér zǒu xiǎn, fān yuè fēng bì de shān dào, tài wēi xiǎn le.
Taking the desperate risk of crossing a closed mountain path to save time is far too dangerous.

first: 一次失败不该让你一蹶不振，重新准备就有机会。
yī cì shī bài bù gāi ràng nǐ yī jué bù zhèn, chóng xīn zhǔn bèi jiù yǒu jī huì.
One failure should not keep you down; preparing again gives you another chance.
second: 那家工厂失去主要客户后，一蹶不振了好几年。
nà jiā gōng chǎng shī qù zhǔ yào kè hù hòu, yī jué bù zhèn le hǎo jǐ nián.
After losing its main client, the factory failed to recover for several years.

first: 为了让大家都吃得开心，爸爸为菜单煞费苦心。
wèi le ràng dà jiā dōu chī de kāi xīn, bà ba wèi cài dān shà fèi kǔ xīn.
Dad put great thought into the menu so that everyone would enjoy the meal.
second: 设计师为这间小屋的空间安排煞费苦心。
shè jì shī wèi zhè jiān xiǎo wū de kōng jiān ān pái shà fèi kǔ xīn.
The designer took great pains over the layout of this small room.

first: 这幅画是我第一次尝试，我难免敝帚自珍。
zhè fú huà shì wǒ dì yī cì cháng shì, wǒ nán miǎn bì zhǒu zì zhēn.
This painting was my first attempt, so I cannot help treasuring it despite its flaws.
second: 爷爷对旧工具敝帚自珍，一件也舍不得扔。
yé ye duì jiù gōng jù bì zhǒu zì zhēn, yī jiàn yě shě bù de rēng.
Grandpa treasures his worn tools and cannot bear to throw any away.

first: 这所大学人才济济，年轻学者不断涌现。
zhè suǒ dà xué rén cái jǐ jǐ, nián qīng xué zhě bù duàn yǒng xiàn.
This university has many talented people, with young scholars continually emerging.
second: 新的研究团队人才济济，汇集了不同领域的专家。
xīn de yán jiū tuán duì rén cái jǐ jǐ, huì jí le bù tóng lǐng yù de zhuān jiā.
The new research team is full of talent, bringing together experts from different fields.

first: 充分了解市场，才能在竞争中百战不殆。

Understanding the market thoroughly helps one stay secure through repeated competition.
second: 球队想要百战不殆，就必须不断研究对手的战术。
qiú duì xiǎng yào bǎi zhàn bù dài, jiù bì xū bù duàn yán jiū duì shǒu de zhàn shù.
To stay competitive in match after match, the team must keep studying its opponents' tactics.

first: 她津津有味地吃着刚出锅的面条。
tā jīn jīn yǒu wèi de chī zhe gāng chū guō de miàn tiáo.
She ate the freshly cooked noodles with relish.
second: 孩子们津津有味地听着航海故事，谁也不愿离开。
hái zi men jīn jīn yǒu wèi de tīng zhe háng hǎi gù shi, shéi yě bù yuàn lí kāi.
The children listened to the seafaring story with keen interest, and none wanted to leave.

first: 春天的公园绿草如茵，大家在草地边散步。
chūn tiān de gōng yuán lǜ cǎo rú yīn, dà jiā zài cǎo dì biān sàn bù.
The park's grass was lush and green in spring, and people strolled beside the lawn.
second: 雨后的山坡绿草如茵，几只羊正在吃草。
yǔ hòu de shān pō lǜ cǎo rú yīn, jǐ zhī yáng zhèng zài chī cǎo.

first: 两家商店只顾互相压价，鹬蚌相争，反让第三家获利。

The two shops focused on undercutting each other, allowing a third shop to profit from their rivalry.
second: 双方争执不下，正是鹬蚌相争，给了竞争者机会。

The two sides' stubborn dispute gave a competitor an opening.

first: 登上山顶，眼前是一望无垠的草原。

From the summit, the grassland stretched as far as the eye could see.
second: 船离开港口后，四周只剩一望无垠的海面。
chuán lí kāi gǎng kǒu hòu, sì zhōu zhǐ shèng yī wàng wú yín de hǎi miàn.
After the ship left the harbor, an endless sea surrounded it.

first: 纪录片里的灾后景象怵目惊心。

The scenes of the disaster's aftermath in the documentary were shocking.
second: 路边那些被撞毁的车辆，实在怵目惊心。
lù biān nà xiē bèi zhuàng huǐ de chē liàng, shí zài chù mù jīng xīn.
The wrecked vehicles beside the road were truly horrifying to see.

first: 大家已经等了半小时，他才姗姗来迟。

Everyone had waited for half an hour before he finally arrived late.
second: 寒风持续了很久，今年的春天姗姗来迟。
hán fēng chí xù le hěn jiǔ, jīn nián de chūn tiān shān shān lái chí.
The cold winds lasted a long time, and spring arrived late this year.

first: 切断污染源，才是治理河水的釜底抽薪之策。

Stopping the pollution at its source is the way to solve the river's problem at its root.
second: 补上流程漏洞，才能釜底抽薪地减少重复错误。
bǔ shàng liú chéng lòu dòng, cái néng fǔ dǐ chōu xīn de jiǎn shǎo chóng fù cuò wù.
Closing the gaps in the process addresses the root cause of repeated errors.

first: 借高息的新债还旧债，无异于剜肉补疮。

The obstinate manager would not listen to any advice about the risks.
second: 他一向刚愎自用，这次却终于愿意听取同伴的意见。

He had always been stubborn, but this time he finally listened to his companions.

This refined young man always takes the initiative to greet his elders.

Wearing glasses and speaking gently, he looked refined and courteous.

first: 这位代表办事公正，深孚众望，再次当选。

The representative's fairness earned widespread trust, and she was elected again.
second: 她长期帮助邻里，在社区里深孚众望。
tā cháng qī bāng zhù lín lǐ, zài shè qū lǐ shēn fú zhòng wàng.
By helping her neighbors over many years, she earned the community's deep trust.

Everyone was filled with righteous anger on seeing the elderly person deceived.
second: 工人被无故拖欠工资，听到消息的人都义愤填膺。

People who heard that the workers' wages were unfairly withheld were outraged.

first: 没有专业能力却假装懂行，就是滥竽充数。

Pretending to be an expert without the necessary skills is passing oneself off as qualified.

He is so narrow-minded that even a joke makes him seek revenge.
second: 一次无意的冒犯，不值得你这样睚眦必报。

An unintentional slight does not justify such vindictive retaliation.

first: 这匹马桀骜不驯，还没有人能骑上它的背。

This untamed horse had not yet allowed anyone to ride it.
second: 年轻时的他桀骜不驯，总是不肯接受别人的安排。
nián qīng shí de tā jié ào bù xùn, zǒng shì bù kěn jiē shòu bié rén de ān pái.
As a young man he was defiant and always refused to accept other people's plans for him.

first: 敌军败退后惊恐不安，一路风声鹤唳。

The defeated troops retreated in terror, suspecting pursuit at every sound.
second: 几条裁员传闻就让办公室风声鹤唳。
jǐ tiáo cái yuán chuán wén jiù ràng bàn gōng shì fēng shēng hè lì.
A few rumors of layoffs made everyone in the office jumpy and suspicious.

first: 他们合伙欺骗顾客，真是一丘之貉。

They conspired to deceive customers and were all equally bad.
second: 这两家公司都靠假广告赚钱，不过是一丘之貉。

Both companies profited from false advertising; they were no better than each other.

first: 读到母亲留下的信，她忍不住潸然泪下。

Reading the letter her mother left, she could not help shedding tears.
second: 老朋友多年后再次相见，激动得潸然泪下。

The old friends shed tears of emotion when they met again after many years.

After arguing for a long time, both sides finally stopped and began discussing a solution.
second: 连续亏损后，这场价格战终于偃旗息鼓。

After repeated losses, the price war finally subsided.

Knowingly finding customers for a swindler makes one an accomplice in his wrongdoing.
second: 她拒绝帮助坏人隐瞒真相，不愿为虎作伥。

She refused to help the wrongdoers hide the truth and become their accomplice.

first: 考察队栉风沐雨，在山中工作了数月。
kǎo chá duì zhì fēng mù yǔ, zài shān zhōng gōng zuò le shù yuè.
The field team worked in the mountains for months, braving wind and rain.
second: 这些送货员每天栉风沐雨，把包裹送到各家。

These couriers brave the weather every day to deliver parcels to people's homes.

first: 网上的课程良莠不齐，选择时要仔细比较。

Online courses vary in quality, so compare them carefully before choosing.
second: 这批供应商良莠不齐，不能只看报价高低。
zhè pī gōng yìng shāng liáng yǒu bù qí, bù néng zhǐ kàn bào jià gāo dī.
This group of suppliers includes both reliable and poor ones; price alone is not enough.

first: 窗外雨雪霏霏，远处的山村渐渐变白。
chuāng wài yù xuě fēi fēi, yuǎn chù de shān cūn jiàn jiàn biàn bái.
Snow fell thickly outside the window, and the distant mountain village gradually turned white.
second: 天色将晚，雨雪霏霏，行人加快了脚步。
tiān sè jiāng wǎn, yù xuě fēi fēi, xíng rén jiā kuài le jiǎo bù.
As evening approached and snow fell thickly, the travelers quickened their pace.

first: 灾民还在等待援助，衮衮诸公却只顾开会。

The disaster victims were still waiting for aid while the dignitaries concerned themselves only with meetings.
second: 面对这份报告，衮衮诸公仍无人承担责任。
miàn duì zhè fèn bào gào, gǔn gǔn zhū gōng réng wú rén chéng dān zé rèn.
Faced with the report, none of the grand officials would take responsibility.

first: 只读一页就评价整本书，未免管蠡窥测。

Judging an entire book after reading one page is surely too narrow a view.
second: 仅凭一次访问就判断当地生活，难免管蠡窥测。

Assessing local life from a single visit inevitably gives a limited and one-sided picture.

first: 故乡钟灵毓秀，山水优美，出了许多学者。
gù xiāng zhōng líng yù xiù, shān shuǐ yōu měi, chū le xǔ duō xué zhě.
Our hometown's beautiful natural surroundings have nurtured many scholars.
second: 这片钟灵毓秀的土地，孕育了丰富的文化。
zhè piàn zhōng líng yù xiù de tǔ dì, yùn yù le fēng fù de wén huà.
This naturally gifted land has nurtured a rich culture.

first: 穷兵黩武的政策让百姓长期承受战争之苦。
qióng bīng dú wǔ de zhèng cè ràng bǎi xìng cháng qī chéng shòu zhàn zhēng zhī kǔ.
The warmongering policy made ordinary people suffer from prolonged warfare.
second: 他们反对穷兵黩武，主张通过谈判解决争端。
tā men fǎn duì qióng bīng dú wǔ, zhǔ zhāng tōng guò tán pàn jiě jué zhēng duān.
They opposed reckless militarism and advocated resolving the dispute through negotiation.

first: 面对威胁，大家噤若寒蝉，没有人敢说出实情。
miàn duì wēi xié, dà jiā jìn ruò hán chán, méi yǒu rén gǎn shuō chū shí qíng.
Faced with threats, everyone kept silent, and no one dared tell the truth.
second: 经理一发怒，同事们就噤若寒蝉。
jīng lǐ yī fā nù, tóng shì men jiù jìn ruò hán chán.
Whenever the manager became angry, the colleagues fell silent out of fear.

first: 朋友们离开后，他在暮色中踽踽独行。
péng you men lí kāi hòu, tā zài mù sè zhōng jǔ jǔ dú xíng.
After his friends left, he walked alone in the fading light.
second: 空荡的街上，她踽踽独行，身边没有一个同伴。
kōng dàng de jiē shàng, tā jǔ jǔ dú xíng, shēn biān méi yǒu yī gè tóng bàn.
She walked alone down the empty street, without a single companion.
